newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper was called to open firmer on Wednesday despite LME stocks rising sharply overnight, traders said.
COMEX July copper was due to open 0.30 to 0.50 cent firmer from Tuesday's close at 109.05 cents per pound.
On overnight ACCESS trading, July was traded109.65 to 109.00 cents, up 0.60 cent just before COMEX opens.
LME stocks Wednesday rose 3,050 tonnes to 151,975 tonnes, though dealers had been expecting metal to flow into warehouses following the surge in LME backwardation recently.
The LME backwardation on Wednesday was at $63/$65, barely changed from Tuesday.
On Tuesday COMEX stocks fell 1,386 short tons to 45,705 tons.
